message: I'll number each step of the evaluation loop on slide 5.

slides.purpose: Provide the workflow: show how to evaluate and iterate on prompts systematically
slides.content_brief: Two-column slide with a numbered prompt evaluation loop (1. define criteria → 2. build test set → 3. score outputs → 4. refine prompt → 5. repeat) on one side and commentary bullets on the other explaining why each step matters
slides.assumes: Audience is convinced of the value and wants to know how to operationalise it
slides.hands_off: A repeatable evaluate-and-iterate loop is the engine of prompt quality
